list.snippet: C73: Malignant neoplasm of thyroid gland
This code encompasses all types of thyroid cancer, including papillary thyroid carcinoma.
If the cancer has metastasized to the lymph nodes of the head and neck, the code C77.0 may be used instead.
More specific codes may be used to indicate the size, extent, or other characteristics of the tumor.
